dict.string: Blackcrab needs access to your Desktop so your agents can read and edit project files you keep there.
Blackcrab needs access to your Documents folder so your agents can read and edit project files there.
Blackcrab needs access to your Downloads folder so your agents can work with files you've downloaded.
Blackcrab needs access to removable volumes so your agents can work with files on external drives.
Blackcrab needs access to network volumes so your agents can work with files on shared drives.
Blackcrab uses your local network to connect to agent environments and services on your devices.
Blackcrab uses Apple Events to launch and control the integrated terminal.
